pointOverview.infoYou: You: Your current relationship points across all relationships.
pointOverview.infoThey: They: The points your counterparts currently have in your shared relationships.
pointOverview.infoDetail: Points are generated by your logged daily actions (positive/negative). The impact of an action is amplified or reduced by the relationship values (INK: Trust, Attention, Support).

termsAndPrivacy.title: Terms & Privacy
termsAndPrivacy.termsText1: This app is intended for personal use to document relationships and activities. You are responsible for the content you enter. Misuse or unlawful use is not permitted.
termsAndPrivacy.termsText2: The evaluations and displays provided are for guidance only and do not constitute legal, medical, or psychological advice.
termsAndPrivacy.privacyText1: Your data is stored locally on your device. Without an active export or sync function, no data is automatically shared with third parties.
termsAndPrivacy.privacyText2: If you export data or enable synchronisation, responsibility for secure transmission and storage lies with the environment you choose.
